violated_contract: A Helm values change must land under a key the chart actually reads. Charts ignore unknown keys silently, so a misnamed key (a top-level 'operator:' instead of kube-prometheus-stack's 'prometheusOperator:') renders and rolls out green while the intended setting never reaches the workload.
canonical_prevention: Validate prod values files against the set of top-level keys the pinned chart version reads, and assert the rendered workload carries the intended field.
